w:r.w:t: The Movie Recommendation Web Application is a dynamic, API-driven platform designed to help users discover movies tailored to their preferences. It integrates real-time data from The Movie Database (TMDb) API and analyzes user interaction patterns to generate personalized recommendations. The application does not support movie streaming at this stage but may include it in future enhancements.
Browse trending and genre-based movie lists
Generate personalized recommendations based on genre similarity and user behavior
Responsive UI for desktop and mobile
Fast response time for API calls
Actors: User, TMDb API, Firebase Auth
